newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 29.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Tourism-related firms listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets show signs of strong growth with their share prices soaring.
- Local securities authorities in Beijing have taken measures to strengthen risk control in the financial markets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's trade fair industry has developed rapidly in the past several years in step with the development of the city's economy.
- Growth in China's bank deposits has slowed since the People's Bank of China, the central bank, cut interest rates twice last year, in May and August.
